about: Every illustration the Japanese space uses. Generated by hand in the Gemini app (docs/japanese-plan.md §12.1), saved into inbox/ as <id>.png, then imported. The prompt sheet is prototypes/japanese-space/art.html.

styles.colour: STYLE: Match the rendering of the attached style reference (the tall woman in the white coat) exactly — high-quality modern anime illustration, light-novel cover quality, fine clean lineart with thin tapered lines, soft cel shading with gentle gradients, detailed fabric folds, rich but slightly muted colours, natural slender proportions, soft even studio lighting from the front-left. Do NOT draw the woman from the style reference; use her only for the art style.
styles.manga: STYLE: A single black-and-white Japanese manga panel, as printed in a weekly shounen or slice-of-life magazine: crisp black ink lineart, screentone dot shading, solid black hair spots, white highlights, no colour and no grey wash. Same character designs as the attached character sheets.
styles.bg: STYLE: Match the rendering of the attached style reference (painterly anime background art, as in a high-budget TV anime or visual novel): soft painted lighting, clean perspective, gentle depth of field. Do NOT draw the woman from the style reference; use her only for the art style.

rules: Never any text: no letters, no Japanese, no speech bubbles, no captions, no signatures, no logos. Signs, menus and posters are blank or show pictures only. (All text is added later as a live layer.)
Keep each character's design identical to their sheet: hair, eyes, uniform, colours.
Save each result into art-source/ja/inbox/ with the exact file name shown, as PNG at the highest resolution Gemini offers.

akari.name: 白石 灯 (Shiraishi Akari)
akari.role: Third-year senpai and your guide. Polite です/ます speech, later keigo.
akari.look: a 17-year-old Japanese girl, calm and kind; shoulder-length straight chestnut-brown hair with a thin braid along the left side and a small vermilion hair clip; warm amber eyes; thin oval silver-rimmed glasses; navy school blazer with a small vermilion crest on the chest pocket, white shirt, vermilion ribbon tie, charcoal pleated skirt just above the knee, black tights, brown loafers; average height

yota.name: 朝日 陽太 (Asahi Yōta)
yota.role: Your same-year classmate. Casual speech, anime contractions (じゃん, ちゃう).
yota.look: a 16-year-old Japanese boy, energetic and friendly; messy short dark-brown hair with one stubborn cowlick at the crown; bright grey-blue eyes; lightly tanned; the same navy school blazer with the vermilion crest, worn OPEN over a light grey hoodie whose hood sits outside the collar; vermilion tie worn loose; dark grey trousers; white sneakers; slightly taller than Akari

makoto.name: 小林 誠 (Kobayashi Makoto) — マスター
makoto.role: Owns the café the cast meets in. Older and warm; polite-relaxed speech, set phrases (いらっしゃいませ, どうぞ), later giving and receiving.
makoto.look: a Japanese man in his late forties, tall and broad-shouldered, kind and unhurried; short neat salt-and-pepper hair swept back, a short well-kept greying beard, warm dark-brown eyes with laugh lines, round tortoiseshell glasses pushed slightly down his nose; a white collared shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a dark-brown canvas barista apron with a small vermilion embroidered coffee-bean motif (no lettering), dark trousers, brown leather shoes; a small towel tucked into the apron string

batches.title: Character sheets
batches.why: Everything else is drawn from these, so take the time to get them right. Regenerate until you like the design; later batches attach the sheet you keep.

batches.title: Base poses
batches.why: One full-body pose per character on flat green. Every expression is edited onto this exact image, so the body never moves.

batches.title: Expressions
batches.why: Edits of the base pose. Use Gemini's edit on the base pose image (upload it, then give the prompt). Only the face may change.

batches.title: Backgrounds
batches.why: Reusable places, empty of people. Characters are layered on top.

batches.title: Manga panels
batches.why: The lesson's hook (これ・それ・あれ). Leave the marked space empty — the speech bubbles are added in the app.

batches.title: Stage 1 · unit F1: the café owner
batches.why: A third character for the café scenes in unit F1 (ordering, prices). Same order as before: the sheet first, then the base pose from it, then the four expressions as edits of the base.

batches.title: Stage 1 · unit F1: manga panels
batches.why: Hooks for lessons 1.2 (introductions) and 1.5 (where is it?). Leave the marked space empty — the speech bubbles are added in the app.

batches.title: Stage 1 · unit F2: manga panels
batches.why: Hooks for lessons 2.1 (what time is it?) and 2.6 (phone numbers). Leave the marked space empty — the speech bubbles are added in the app.

Background art: the inside of a small, cosy neighbourhood café in Japan in the afternoon. A wooden counter on the left with a glass cake display, a coffee machine and a few cups; two small tables by a large window on the right with warm sunlight; plants; a chalkboard menu on the back wall with only small drawings of cakes and cups (no writing); a large framed poster of a cartoon cat mascot high on the far wall. Camera at standing eye level, horizon at about 45% of the height, the floor area in the centre left open so characters can stand there. No people. No text anywhere.

Background art: a Japanese high-school classroom after lessons, late afternoon. Rows of wooden desks and chairs, a large green chalkboard on the left wall that is wiped clean, tall windows on the right with golden low sun and light curtains, a few bags on desks. Camera at standing eye level, horizon at about 45% of the height, the aisle in the centre open so characters can stand there. No people. No text anywhere, nothing written on the board.

Background art: a small suburban train station platform in Japan on a clear morning. A long platform with a yellow tactile strip, a simple roof with steel pillars, a vending machine, a bench, overhead wires, houses and trees beyond the tracks, soft blue sky. Signboards are blank coloured panels with no writing. Camera at standing eye level, horizon at about 45% of the height, the platform in the centre open so characters can stand there. No people, no train. No text anywhere.

A wide establishing panel inside the café from the attached background. Yōta (left, from his sheet) holds a plate with a slice of strawberry shortcake close to his own chest and looks at it curiously. Akari (right, from her sheet) stands about two metres from him holding a tall iced drink in her hand, smiling. Far behind them, high on the back wall and clearly distant from both, the big framed poster of the cartoon cat mascot. The three objects — the cake near Yōta, the drink near Akari, the poster far away — must all be clearly readable. Leave the top 25% of the panel above each character's head as plain empty background for speech bubbles. No speech bubbles, no text, no sound effects.

A tall panel, medium close-up from a low angle: Yōta (from his sheet) points far into the distance past the viewer's right with an excited curious face, his other hand still holding the cake plate; Akari (from her sheet) behind his shoulder follows his finger with her eyes, amused. Speed lines behind Yōta's pointing arm. Leave the top-left 30% of the panel as plain empty space for a speech bubble. No speech bubbles, no text, no sound effects.
